short: the serving hub's loops and processes
is: The parts of `zaf hub` that touch the machine: the loop that feeds the LAN page, the service verbs, and the tick and watch the page's controls run as the spawn verb in a project's root.
conventions: The hub serves every project from one folder and a tick finds its project from the folder it runs in, so each tick is a process of its own in the project's root

fs.name: dashboard.rs
fs.role: `zaf hub --port <n>`: the loop that feeds app::hub's server; a new report is the only thing that reads the board and publishes a frame

fs.name: service.rs
fs.role: `zaf hub service install | remove`: reads the machine and prints the outcome; macOS has no service yet and exits 64

fs.name: tick.rs
fs.role: the Ticker behind `POST /api/tick`: `zaf spawn --once --no-wait --version <v>` in the project's root, waited for only WAIT, the answer being what it printed so far

fs.name: watch.rs
fs.role: the tick of `POST /api/watch`: `zaf spawn --once` in a process group of its own, told whose tick it is (SCHEDULED_BY_VAR) since the hub holds the project's scheduler lock, and waited for to its end

notes: The server, the guard and the controls themselves are app/hub/
dashboard/, service/, tick/ and watch/ hold only tests.rs
